subject: Vendr onboarding — compact evidence snapshot request (ClearSky)
messages:
From: Amir Khan <amir@clearsky.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearsky.com
Date: Sat, 9 Sep 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — Vendr onboarding minimal evidence

Hey Jonas,

We're doing a lightweight intake for our vendor portal (Vendr) and need a compact evidence snapshot from vendors who already have SOC 2 + CAIQ mappings. Can Redwood provide a small manifest we can attach to our OneTrust profile that lists: SOC 2 coverage summary, CAIQ/SIG pointers, and a couple of downloadable artefacts (system diagram + encryption KMS statement)?

We're trying to limit scope — total upload should be < 10 files and no more than ~50MB. Timeline: would really appreciate something by EOD 2028-09-11 to hit our procurement window.

Thanks — Amir
Amir Khan
Security Programs Manager, ClearSky Inc.

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Amir Khan <amir@clearsky.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 9 Sep 2028 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — Vendr onboarding minimal evidence

Hi Amir —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can produce a compact manifest that meets your constraints. Proposed deliverables:
- SOC 2 one-page coverage summary (what the control domains cover for vendor-facing ingestion)
- CAIQ map (high-level: which CAIQ questions we answer and links to corresponding artifacts)
- System diagram (PDF, annotated)
- KMS/Encryption statement (PDF)
- Link to a short SOC 2 report extract (PDF) for procurement review

Marissa and Camila, can you assemble the artifact bundle and create the Vendr manifest CSV that lists file names, short descriptions, and TTL for refresh? Ben — heads-up, procurement may ask for a signed attestation; can you prepare the e-sign path in case?

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Partner, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — Vendr onboarding minimal evidence

> Hi Amir —
>
> Thanks for the clear ask. We can produce a compact manifest that meets your constraints.

Team — quick status: I pulled the SOC 2 extract and a one-page coverage doc (attached as SOC2-snapshot-2028Q2.pdf). Camila attached an annotated system diagram and a short KMS statement draft. I also generated a Vendr manifest CSV listing four artifacts (see vendr_compact_manifest.csv).

Camila: small ask — please clip the CAIQ mapping to the questions ClearSky flagged (I highlighted them inline in the spreadsheet). Aim: one table with question id, our short answer, and link to artifact.

Amir — attaching the two PDFs now and the manifest CSV (included below as a stub) — we plan to upload these to Vendr and share the OneTrust profile link. If you need a signed attestation we can route to Ben for e-sign today.

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2028Q2.pdf (extract), vendr_compact_manifest.csv (csv stub), system-diagram-v2.pdf, kms-statement-2028.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
